title: Deploy WireGuard VPN Site-to-Site
description: Configure WireGuard VPN tunnel between two sites with proper routing and firewall rules.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Deploy WireGuard site-to-site VPN — configure tunnel, routing, firewall rules, and verify connectivity.

### Environment
- Image: ubuntu:22.04
- Tools: wireguard, iptables, ip route
- Login: itadmin / ItLab2025!

### Tasks
1. Install WireGuard on both nodes
2. Generate key pairs for both peers
3. Configure wg0 interface on site A
4. Configure wg0 interface on site B
5. Set up iptables rules for forwarding
6. Configure routing between subnets
7. Start WireGuard tunnels
8. Verify end-to-end connectivity

### Verification
- wg show shows connected peers
- Ping across tunnel succeeds
- Routing table includes tunnel routes

flags.title: WireGuard Installed
flags.description: Run: wg --version | head -1. What version?

flags.title: Keys Generated
flags.description: Run: ls /etc/wireguard/*.key | wc -l. How many key files?

flags.title: Interface Up
flags.description: Run: ip addr show wg0 | grep -c 'inet'. Is the interface configured?

flags.title: Peers Configured
flags.description: Run: wg show wg0 | grep -c 'peer'. How many peers?

flags.title: Handshake
flags.description: Run: wg show wg0 | grep 'latest handshake' | grep -v 'none' | wc -l. Has a handshake occurred?

flags.title: Tunnel Ping
flags.description: Run: ping -c 3 10.0.0.2 | grep -c 'bytes from'. How many replies?

flags.title: Firewall Rules
flags.description: Run: iptables -L FORWARD -n | grep -c 'ACCEPT'. How many forwarding rules?

flags.title: Persistent Config
flags.description: Run: systemctl is-enabled wg-quick@wg0. Is it enabled on boot?
